newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, business slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, business slow.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were narrowly mixed, with a few upward price blips attributed to feedmixers needing some prompt shipped material during this holiday-shorteneded week, dealers said.

However, most dealers said millfeed prices have a weak tone because corn and other ingredients are replacing millfeeds in feed mixes. In Southeast markets, some dealers said lower-priced corn was displacing millfeeds.
"We have trucks (of millfeeds) sitting and can't get unloaded," said a Carolina dealer. He said feedmixers were favoring corn, which was priced $5 per ton less than millfeeds.
Buffalo sources also reported lower-priced corn was displacing millfeeds, and Chattanooga sources said corn and soybean hulls were effectively competing with millfeeds.
